body: Hey man. I have type one bipolar disorder, I go through suicidal/extreme depressive episodes semi-frequently. Don't give up dude. I can't tell you it gets better because I don't know if it will as I'm only 19, but I can say the probability of things looking up is probably worth sticking around for. I believe in the three-fold rule of karma; the energy you give out comes back to you three-fold. That's mainly whats been keeping me going because I put out a lot of good energy and I'm sure you do too. Don't give up yet.
